claims.text: Input clarification ensembling is an uncertainty decomposition framework that can be applied to any pre-trained LLM.
Input clarification ensembling generates a set of input clarifications, feeds them into an LLM, and ensembles the corresponding predictions.

Input clarification ensembling makes it possible to factor an LLM's predictions into separate aleatoric and epistemic terms when aleatoric uncertainty arises from input ambiguity or under-specification.
Input clarification ensembling provides accurate and reliable uncertainty quantification on several language processing tasks.

evidence.description: Empirical evaluations demonstrate that input clarification ensembling provides accurate and reliable uncertainty quantification on several language processing tasks.

methodologies.name: Input Clarification Ensembling
methodologies.description: A framework that generates clarifications for LLM inputs and ensembles predictions to factor total uncertainty into separate aleatoric and epistemic terms.

limitations.text: Identifying sources of uncertainty in large language models remains an important open research question.
